candidates: When reviewing new files added under `src/export-mocks/`, check that all imports are actually used by the file's implementation and that exports are structured without unnecessary indirection (e.g., values should be exported directly rather than being wrapped in an intermediate object first).

When reviewing or implementing mocks for Next.js components in `src/export-mocks/`, ensure all prop-driven behavioral modes are faithfully reproduced. For the `Link` mock specifically, when `legacyBehavior` is `true` the mock must pass navigation props through to its child element (mirroring the real Next.js `Link` behavior) rather than always rendering its own `<a>` element — see https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/b0595b17ae331a2e1cccff35da8d093f0636c8e1/packages/next/src/client/link.tsx#L680-L690.
